name: attach_uploaded_document_to_user_tag
description: Attaches an uploaded document URL to user.tag[fieldName], then returns remaining missing fields.

fieldName.description: Document field name from user config, for example identityDocument

name: create_document_upload_session
description: Creates upload instructions for a required document field before linking it to a user profile.

fieldName.description: Document field name from user config, for example identityDocument

originalFileName.description: Original file name, for example id-card.jpg

mimeType.description: MIME type, for example image/jpeg or application/pdf

name: create_user
description: Creates a new user profile. It can be a normal customer or a driver or a store owner depending on the role specified in the profile object.

name: find_order_by_id
description: Find order by id and return the order details

name: find_order_for_messenger
description: Find order by id and return the order details as MessengerOrderDto

name: find_orders_by_messenger_id
description: Find orders by messenger id and return the order details as MessengerOrderDto

name: find_orders_by_phone_number
description: Find orders by phone number and return the order details

name: find_orders_by_user_id
description: Find orders by user id and return the order details

name: find_store_or_shops_by_id
description: Find a store profile by its ID. If the store has no business hours set, default hours will be added.

name: find_stores
description: Find stores with optional filters. All parameters are optional — pass null to skip a filter. city: case-insensitive substring of the store address. storeType: one of FOOD, CLOTHING, SALON, CAR_WASH, MOVERS, TIPS, LICENSING, PARTS. activeStatus: true = only available (non-OFFLINE) stores, false = only OFFLINE stores, null = all.

city.description: Optional city name — case-insensitive substring match against store address. Pass null to skip.

storeType.description: Optional store type — one of FOOD, CLOTHING, SALON, CAR_WASH, MOVERS, TIPS, LICENSING, PARTS. Pass null to skip.

activeStatus.description: Optional availability filter — true = non-OFFLINE stores only, false = OFFLINE stores only, null = no filter.

name: find_stores_by_owner
description: Find all store profiles owned by a specific user ID.

name: find_user_by_phone
description: Finds a user profile by phone number. It will try to find the userby adding different country code prefixes to the phone number provided.

name: find_users
description: finds users by role and location. It will return a list of user profiles that match the specified role and are within the specified range of the given latitude and longitude.

role.description: This will always have a value MESSENGER because this serach is only allow to search drivers available

range.description: range is in degrees. 1 degree is approximately 111 km. So a range of 0.01 would be approximately 1.11 km

name: get_missing_fields_by_phone
description: Returns a list of missing mandatory field names for the user profile associated with the given mobile number.

name: get_payouts_for_user
description: Get all payouts for a given payout type, date range and toId. The default date range is past 7 days. The Payout will have all orders for this payout and the total amount for the payout. For driver the payoutType is MESSENGER and the toId is the driver id. For shop the payoutType is SHOP and the toId is the shop id.

payoutType.description: For driver the payoutType is MESSENGER

toId.description: This is the Driver/Messenger id to use for lookup

name: get_required_documents_for_user
description: Returns required document fields and missing fields for the user linked to a phone number.

name: recheck_required_documents
description: Rechecks required fields and required document fields after uploads.

name: start_order
description: Creates a new order for a customer. customerConfirmed MUST be true — only call this after the customer has explicitly confirmed they want to place the order. idempotencyKey MUST be unique per order attempt; duplicate calls within 24 hours return the existing order. orderType must be ONLINE or INSTORE. basketJson is a JSON-serialised Basket with an items array. shippingDataJson is a JSON-serialised ShippingData (required for ONLINE orders, null for INSTORE).

customerConfirmed.description: Must be true — agent must have confirmed the customer's intent before placing the order

idempotencyKey.description: Unique key for this order attempt to prevent duplicate orders

shopId.description: The store/shop ID to place the order against

basketJson.description: JSON of the Basket with items array, e.g. {"items":[{"name":"chips","quantity":2,"price":10,"totalPrice":20}]}

shippingDataJson.description: JSON of ShippingData (required for ONLINE orders). null for INSTORE orders.
